services.desc: The best screen-free family activity in Boise. Our rooms are fun, not scary - with unlimited hints and a dedicated game master so everyone has a great time. Ages 8 and up welcome. If you've never done an escape room with kids before, you might be wondering: Is it too hard? Will they get scared? What if they get frustrated? We hear these questions all the time - and the answer to all three is no. Our rooms at Escape The Room Boise are designed to be exciting, not frightening. Think of it as a live-action puzzle adventure, not a haunted house.
